Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: the old residential block's street doorway at the FAR end of the depth axis and a little left of centre, two or three worn concrete steps up to a half-open metal gate with the stairwell light glowing through the gap, and one old street lamp directly overhead switched on and throwing a warm yellow pool over the doorstep; the concrete steps and the ground along the bottom third; 忠叔 (S18) up on those steps under the lamp, above and beyond 苏小满 (S1), in the middle-ground right of centre; 苏小满 (S1) at the foot of the steps in the near half a little left of centre, one depth step nearer the camera; a bicycle leaning against the wall beside the gate and a few old flyers on the wall; it is night and the street lamp, the stairwell light and the lamps along the street are all on; 忠叔 (S18) gone far off; 苏小满 (S1) alone at the foot of the steps
[Shot 1] Wide closing on the street doorway of the old low-rise block: the concrete steps, the half-open metal gate, the bicycle leaning against the wall beside it and the old flyers pasted there are all lit in the warm yellow of the old street lamp, and the stairwell light is on as well; 忠叔 (S18)'s back has gone far off down the street and 苏小满 (S1) stands alone at the foot of the steps in the near half; the bottom third is the concrete steps and the worn ground, and the night is lit rather than dark.
[Shot 2] At 00:07.000, She stands still at the foot of the steps and the doorway holds its light.
soundscape: The street lamp's hum, the stairwell light's buzz, his keys jingling far off, then the open night taking over.
music: A low string rises and lifts once, then holds suspended.
